scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to Tachikawa's second conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Tachikawas-second-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 199 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 332c2535f60d4ad6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B be a finite-dimensional symmetric algebra over a field and let N be a finite-dimensional nonprojective left B-module satisfying Exti B(N, N) = 0 for all i > 0. Put G = B ⊕ N, Γ = EndB(G)op , where endomorphisms compose in the ordinary order. Then domdim(ΓΓ) = ∞, idΓ Γ = ∞. In particular, Γ is not self-injective.
